context: Em practice_first, ou numa revisita, o aluno implementa a variação e explica a decisão sem ajuda.
expected: shorten or omit redundant exposition
offer a transfer variation
retain verification and learner explanation
forbidden: force every phase for its own sake
record phase completion as evidence
shorten the theory of a new topic in theory_first

context: O aluno repete a mesma causa de erro e não consegue explicar o comportamento.
expected: split the task or retrieve the prerequisite
increase concrete examples and support
pause advancement until the prerequisite is usable
forbidden: mark the learner incorrect for an unintroduced concept
restart the entire curriculum

context: O aluno conclui uma etapa depois de receber uma pista parcial.
expected: reduce one level of support
change the context or task variation
require a later prompt-only attempt for autonomous evidence
forbidden: classify the guided attempt as independent evidence

context: O aluno domina o boilerplate, mas encontra um novo núcleo cognitivo na integração.
expected: use performance for the demonstrated part
route the new cognitive core to learning or assessment
retain learner verification and final judgment
forbidden: force one mode for the whole session

context: Em practice_first, restam poucos minutos e a tarefa ainda precisa de uma tentativa autônoma.
expected: trim optional explanation or polish
protect the learner attempt and verification
record a checkpoint for the next smallest delivery
forbidden: skip the cognitive-core attempt merely to finish the phase list

context: Uma competência já praticada retorna no projeto com formato de dados e falha novos.
expected: connect the revisit to the current project
increase complexity only after demonstrated readiness
collect the new transfer behavior
forbidden: treat the revisit as identical repetition

context: A sessão foi interrompida durante a prática guiada após um erro de causa conhecida.
expected: resume the checkpoint and current support level
continue with the smallest useful variation
do not restart the entire probe or lesson
forbidden: infer mastery from the interrupted session alone

context: Em theory_first, a lição abre um tópico ainda não ensinado neste estudo.
expected: open the theory with the concrete problem and why it exists
teach how it works, define every term, and read a basic example line by line
cover common errors and limits, run short understanding checks, and bridge to the project
write the theory in the lesson file before the first practice task
forbidden: probe the new topic before its theory
start guided or independent practice before the understanding checks unless the learner says they understood
count the theory or the understanding checks as evidence

context: Em theory_first, a sessão não comporta a teoria completa e a prática do tópico novo.
expected: finish the theory and its understanding checks
record a checkpoint naming the pending practice
open the next session of the same lesson with a short retrieval before practice
forbidden: cut or compress the theory to fit the clock
skip the cognitive-core attempt instead of deferring it
restart the theory from scratch in the next session

context: O diagnóstico marcou o tópico como likely_known, mas ele ainda não foi ensinado neste estudo e entrou na lição atual.
expected: treat the topic as new and start from zero knowledge
define every term before using it
forbidden: shorten the theory or term definitions because of the diagnostic estimate
treat prior study outside this program as taught

context: O estudo usa theory_first e o aluno pede: nesta lição quero ir direto para a prática.
expected: use practice_first for this session with lean theory and every new term defined
record teaching_approach practice_first on the session
keep study-config.json teaching_policy unchanged
forbidden: change study-config.json without an explicit request for a lasting change and confirmation
skip theory entirely for a new topic

context: Em theory_first, o exemplo aprofundado da teoria seria quase idêntico à tarefa independente do projeto.
expected: choose a worked example that differs materially from the independent task
keep the cognitive core of the project task for the learner's attempt
forbidden: solve the independent task inside the theory
record a retyped near-identical solution as independent evidence

context: O estudo usa theory_first, o aluno pediu practice_first nesta lição e a lição continua numa nova sessão.
expected: copy teaching_approach practice_first from the lesson's previous session
keep study-config.json teaching_policy unchanged
forbidden: silently return to theory_first in the same lesson
carry the override to a different lesson

context: Um estudo criado antes da abordagem de ensino tem uma lição in_progress com evidências, e o arquivo da lição não tem teoria escrita.
expected: treat the topic as already taught
write a short theory summary in the lesson file
resume the practice from the checkpoint
forbidden: restart the complete theory from zero
change mastery or evidence because of the summary
